steps.text: Place the cucumber slices into a colander set in the sink, and sprinkle with salt. Set aside and allow to drip.

In a salad bowl, mix together the red onion, red bell pepper, lime zest and juice, cilantro, sugar, curry powder, and hot pepper sauce until thoroughly combined and the sugar has dissolved. Drain the cucumber slices, and pat them dry with paper towels. Stir the cucumbers into the salad. Gently toss the avocados with the salad and serve.

raw_recipe.headline: Cool Cucumber and Avocado Salad
raw_recipe.description: A hint of curry powder, lime juice and zest, and a bit of spice from hot pepper sauce add zing to this cooling, summery cucumber and avocado salad.
raw_recipe.name: Cool Cucumber and Avocado Salad

review.reviewBody: I made this for lunch today. I don't care for curry powder so I left it and the sugar out of the recipe. I added a few splashes of seasoned rice wine vinegar instead. I loved it! I will make it often with my changes. PS, try adding some salad shrimp....wow!

DELICIOUS!! I omitted red bell pepper/hot pepper sauce and substituted in a chopped fresh jalapeno. This salad is so unique and extremely healthy!! My boyfriend and I were extremely surprised at how satisfying the salad was without any oil.

I also used regular cucumbers from my garden that had lots of seeds, so instead of using hothouse cucumbers and using salt to draw out water, I scooped out regular cucumbers and it worked beautifully.

I also did not put the avocado in because I was making a large portion to store in the fridge for later.

AMAZING! :)

First time, I didn't use the red pepper or the red onion as I didn't have. I also used the small Persian cucumbers (peeled). It was so good, I made it the 2nd time, including all ingredients, same cucumbers, this time we put on top of grilled swordfish, which was an excellent addition to the fish. All the lime juice also kept the avocado from turning brown. This recipe will be made many more times this summer.
Good recipe. I added a jalapeno pepper and some diced tomato. It had a little bite that I like in salsa.

Unique way to dress up summer's garden veggies, and the recipe lends itself well to add-ins or subs. In my version I used a regular cuke and added chopped tomatoes (both seeded); a drizzle of avocado oil for extra pizazz and flavor. Delicious to drain and spoon into pita bread that is spread with hummus.
Superb!! So fresh tasting, love the combo of veggies, but I omitted the sugar because I eat keto, no need for it at all.

Very nice in a hot summer day. The curry is an unexpected surprise. I will probably salt the cucumbers with more salt and let them sit longer before rinsing. The dish was a bit soupy by next day. I’ll be making this again.

OMG! I could eat this til my belly popped. It is so DELICIOUS, however, I did make one change. I eliminated the sugar and replaced it with balsamic vinegar. GREAT sugar FREE vegetarian and gluten free dish.

Very yummy salad! I cut this recipe in half, and my husband and I shared it for lunch. I added double the amount of curry and put in a nice big squirt of Sriracha for the hot sauce. I had to use lemon juice as I didn't have any lime. I will definitely make this salad again! Thanks!

I made with six cucumbers. The differences I changed 1/2 c red onions,1 1/2 red pepper,1/2 teas curry powder, 1/2 teas salt. I loved this recipe. My five and eight year loved it. So for that reason also, it is a keeper. Great summer salad.

Even though my outdoor temp gauge now reads 9 deg F and there's 5 ft of snow outside, I still enjoyed this cool and refreshing salad! I halved the recipe and enjoyed it as a dinner salad. I worked with what I had on hand so I had to use bottled lime juice (so no zest). I also topped it with a very light sprinkle of sea salt and cracked black pepper. Great flavors and textures. Will have to keep this in mind for the warmer weather, when it gets here! Thanks javaqueen!
I used cherry tomatoes instead of red pepper. Good, but the curry powder crowded out most of the rest of the flavors.
I left out the cilantro cause I’m not a fan but and didn’t have hot sauce so added a little wasabi sauce. It was delicious and my husband loved it
This is tasty! Very fresh. Could probably be eaten with chips like a fresh salsa.
Easy fresh salad. I love the mix of avocado and veggies. The curry powder gives it a unique yummy taste. Cut back on the lime juice a bit. Just my preference.
Loved this minus the Cilantro!
Modified with no pepper ?? or curry ?? powder

Wonderful, easy salad! I left out the curry intentionally (not a fan), so adjusting to personal preference is simple. I might add tomatoes or feta next time as they seem like they would complement the overall flavor.
made this exactly as is and it was surprisingly delicious! Loved it as a side to our burgers on a hot summer day using the cucumbers we grew in our garden! DEEEEELISH!

The one draw back to this recipe is that it is fairly labor intensive. On the other hand, the results are terrific. Even a guest, who does not like avocado, found this to be very flavorful. I followed the recipe as written.
